## File Summaries

### playbook.yml
Manages xswcore Brocade ICX-7250 stack via ansible.netcommon.cli_config. Terminal plugin: plugins/terminal/icx.py (local, no community.network dependency). Run with: just configure-xswcore First run (password auth, no key): just reconfigure-xswcore

### requirements.yml
Ansible collections required for xswcore (Brocade ICX-7250) management Install with: just install-collections

### inventory.yml
Static inventory for xswcore (Brocade ICX-7250 stack) ansible_private_key_file and ansible_become_password are injected at runtime from nix/secrets/ansible-network.yaml via the justfile recipe.

### default.nix
Nixible configuration for xswcore (Brocade ICX-7250 2-unit stack) Manages core switching: LAGs, VLANs, interfaces, routing, and services Uses ansible.netcommon.cli_config + local terminal plugin (plugins/terminal/icx.py) and cliconf plugin (plugins/cliconf/icx.py) — set ANSIBLE_TERMINAL_PLUGINS / ANSIBLE_CLICONF_PLUGINS to this directory's plugins/{terminal,cliconf} when running.  2026-08-17: rewritten to be a faithful, complete mirror of playbook.yml (the hand-maintained Ansible file this switch was actually deployed from — this default.nix existed but was never wired into flake.nix's nixible apps, so it silently drifted out of sync with every change made via playbook.yml since 2026-08-04). Now registered as `xswcore` in flake.nix, matching every other nixable host's pattern (`nix run .#xswcore`). playbook.yml/inventory.yml/ requirements.yml are kept as-is for now as a fallback until `nix run .#xswcore` is verified end-to-end against the real switch — do not delete them yet.
